title: 陶器製のペデスタル洗面台
description: 建物の洗面室に置く据置きの陶器洗面台。曲面の脚と中空の鉢、吐水面付きのシングルレバー混合水栓、排水口、背面支持部を備えます。仮設手洗い装置とは別の固定内装器具です。水、完全な給排水系統、通水・温度調節はなく、衛生・施工基準への適合は未検証。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）0.608 × 1.045 × 0.515 m、5,692三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A fixed ceramic washbasin for building washrooms, with a curved pedestal, hollow basin, single-lever mixer-shaped faucet with outlet face, drain and rear supports. This is a fixed interior fixture rather than a portable handwash machine. Water, complete supply/waste plumbing, flow and temperature control are absent; hygiene and installation-standard compliance are unvalidated. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 0.608 × 1.045 × 0.515 m; 5,692 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
